# Calculus schema reference

Conventions: lengths in **mm**, angles in **radians**, **Z is up**, everything
else SI. Objects are identified by **UUID** `id`, never by name or index. For
the exact JSON Schema of any type (all fields, not just the required ones), call
the `describe` tool with `{ "type": "<type>" }`.

## Operations

| Tool | Kind | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addObjects` | write | Add objects to the model |
| `updateObjects` | destructive | Replace existing objects, matched by `id` |
| `patchObjects` | destructive | Partially update existing objects: merge `properties` onto the current object with matching `id`, leaving unspecified fields untouched |
| `removeObjects` | destructive | Remove objects by id, keeping the document consistent: nothing is left referencing a removed object |
| `transformObjects` | destructive | Move — or with `copy: true`, copy — objects by id, without touching the selection |
| `getAllObjects` | read-only | List objects in the model, optionally filtered by `type` |
| `getObject` | read-only | Return a single object by id, or null if there is no such object |
| `countByType` | read-only | Return a count of objects per `type` — a cheap overview of the model before deciding what to read in detail |
| `getBoundingBox` | read-only | Return the global axis-aligned bounding box (mm, Z up) enclosing the given object `ids`, or the whole model when `ids` is omitted/empty |
| `getRelatedObjects` | read-only | Return objects connected to the given `ids` through id references, in either direction |
| `getModel` | read-only | Return the entire model snapshot (objects plus catalogs, analytical models, views, filters) |
| `getSelection` | read-only | Return the ids of the objects currently selected in the editor |
| `setSelection` | write | Replace the editor selection with exactly these object ids |
| `addToSelection` | write | Add object ids to the current selection (union, not replace) |
| `clearSelection` | write | Clear the editor selection |
| `setActiveModel` | write | Switch the active view between the BIM (structural) model and an analytical (FEM) model |
| `setStructuralRepresentation` | write | Set how the structural model is drawn |
| `setAnalyticalRepresentation` | write | Set how the analytical model is drawn |
| `setSidebarTab` | write | Open a sidebar pane, or collapse the sidebar |
| `setViewFilter` | write | Toggle which object categories are visible |
| `getProjectInfo` | read-only | Return project metadata: id, name, authors, and userdata key/value pairs |
| `setProjectName` | write | Rename the current project |
| `listProjects` | read-only | Read-only |
| `createProject` | write | Create a new project (optionally named) and open it in the editor — the app navigates to the editor screen and subsequent model operations act on the new, empty model |
| `openProject` | write | Open a stored project in the editor — the app navigates to the editor screen and subsequent model operations act on that project's model |
| `closeProject` | write | Close the currently open project: pending changes are autosaved, then the app returns to its start screen |
| `deleteProject` | destructive | Permanently delete a stored project and its autosaved model from this device |
| `renameProject` | write | Rename a stored project by id (the name is kept in sync inside its .calculus document) |
| `listProfiles` | read-only | List the section profiles available to the project, INCLUDING the built-in system catalogs (IPE, HEA, HEB, HEM, UPE/UPN, L angles, SHS, RHS, CHS, …) |
| `getBeamProfile` | read-only | Resolve a profile `name` as a BEAM section (the catalog/parametric section used by beams, columns and member1D — but NOT plates or member2D panels, which use getPlateProfile) |
| `getPlateProfile` | read-only | Resolve a profile `name` as a PLATE / member2D-panel thickness |
| `listMaterials` | read-only | List the materials available to the project, INCLUDING the built-in system catalogs (e.g |
| `listBolts` | read-only | List the bolt assembly standards available to the project, INCLUDING the built-in system catalog(s) |
| `listRebars` | read-only | List the rebar grades/sizes available to the project, INCLUDING the built-in system catalog(s) |
| `describe` | read-only | Introspect the model schema |
| `undo` | write | Undo the last model change (same as the editor's Undo) |
| `redo` | write | Redo the change that was just undone (same as the editor's Redo) |
| `deleteSelection` | destructive | Delete the objects (and selected handles) currently selected in the editor |
| `hideSelection` | write | Hide the currently selected objects (adds them to the force-hidden set so they stay hidden regardless of the view filter) and clear the selection |
| `clearModel` | destructive | Remove all objects and references from the current model and clear the undo history |
| `zoomToModel` | write | Fit the camera to the whole model (same as the editor's Zoom to Fit) |
| `zoomToSelection` | write | Fit the camera to the current selection (same as the editor's Zoom to Selection) — the whole model when nothing is selected |
| `calculateAnalyticalModel` | write | Calculate the active analytical model: mesh and solve every load case linearly, then run its analyses (`analysis` objects: 'linearStatic', 'linearStability') |
| `getAnalysisJob` | read-only | The state of an analysis started with `calculateAnalyticalModel({ async: true })`: `status` running / succeeded / failed / cancelled, while running the solve's `progress` (phase: meshing, assembly, ordering, factorization, loadCases, stability; fraction 0–1 — none before the first report), and once it ended `result` — what the synchronous call returns |
| `cancelAnalysis` | read-only | Stop the running FEM calculation (started by `calculateAnalyticalModel` or the user) |
| `exportCalculus` | read-only | Serialize the current model to the native `.calculus` (JSON) format and return it as text |
| `exportIfc` | read-only | Export the model to IFC and return the file as base64 |
| `getCamera` | read-only | Read the current camera state: world-space `position` and `target` (orbit center) in mm, and orthographic `zoom` |
| `setCamera` | write | Move the camera |
| `setView` | write | Orient the camera to a standard view, keeping the current orbit center and distance |
| `getFemResultsInfo` | read-only | Read the current FEM-results view state and the ids needed to drive it: the active model, which analytical models have solved results, the active result type, and the load cases / combinations / groups defined on the active analytical model (pass these ids to `showFemResults`) |
| `hideFemResults` | write | Stop drawing FEM results |
| `showFemResults` | write | Display FEM results in the viewport |
| `getNodeDisplacements` | read-only | Solved nodal displacements per analytical node: translations ux/uy/uz (mm), rotations rx/ry/rz (rad), and the translation magnitude `u` (mm), plus the node's position |
| `getReactions` | read-only | Support reactions per supported FE node (concentrated, so a line or area support's share of each node — use getSupportReactions for kN/m, kN/m²) |
| `getSupportReactions` | read-only | Support reactions per SUPPORT: point supports in kN / kNm, line supports as an intensity in kN/m / kNm/m at each FE node along them (`s` = mm from the line's first node), area supports in kN/m² / kNm/m², and every support's resultant (kN / kNm about `centroid`) |
| `getShellStresses` | read-only | Stresses for each member2D (shell) panel in MPa, in the panel's local CS, derived from the solved shell forces + thickness: von Mises and the in-plane sigX, sigY (normal) and tauXY (shear) |
| `getMemberForces` | read-only | Internal forces for each member1D in the member's local CS: N (axial), Vy/Vz (shear) in kN, Mx (torsion)/My/Mz (bending) in kNm |
| `getStabilityResults` | read-only | Buckling results of a solved linear stability analysis (an `analysis` object with analysisType 'linearStability'; run calculateAnalyticalModel first) |
| `getBucklingMode` | read-only | One buckling mode of a solved linear stability analysis in detail |
| `createAnalyticalModel` | write | Create a new, empty analytical (FEM) model and return its id |
| `listAnalyticalModels` | read-only | List the analytical (FEM) models in the project — id, name, visibility, and whether each has solved results — plus the id of the active model (or null when the BIM model is active) |
| `renameAnalyticalModel` | write | Rename an analytical (FEM) model |
| `removeAnalyticalModel` | destructive | Delete an analytical (FEM) model and cascade-delete all of its objects (nodes, members, supports, loads, cases, combinations) and its results |
| `createAnalyticalModelFromSelected` | write | Build a new analytical (FEM) model from the selected structural beams and plates: beams become 1D members, plates become 2D members, with a shared node pool (coincident endpoints within 1mm collapse to one node) |
| `splitMembersAtIntersections` | write | Split the selected 1D members wherever they intersect, inserting shared nodes so the structure is connected for analysis (a common 'fix' step) |
| `fixProfilesToSimilar` | write | Repair beams whose profile name is not in any catalog by substituting the closest matching catalog profile (by name similarity) |
| `findUnconnectedNodes` | read-only | Nodes of an analytical model that carry a point support or point load but that no member uses (no 1D member ends there, no 2D member corner, no node link — and, with connectMembers on, not lying on a member) |
| `snapUnconnectedNodes` | write | Fix unconnected nodes (see findUnconnectedNodes): retarget their point supports and loads to the nearest member node within the merge tolerance and remove the stray nodes — one undo step |
| `filterObjects` | read-only | Run a filter query over the model and return the matching objects |
| `selectByFilter` | write | Select every object matching a filter query, replacing the selection (or adding to it with `add: true`) |
| `setViewFilterQuery` | write | Set (or clear) the view's filter query — what the 3D view draws, on top of the category toggles |
| `listFilterProperties` | read-only | List the properties a filter query can use — schema fields, computed properties (length, area, volume, weight), linked properties that hop through a naming field (`profile.type`, `profile.A`, `material.type`, `material.E` read the catalog entry; `component.definitionId`, `component.params.<key>` read the component instance that owns the object, an instance being its own component) and view pseudo-properties — with their value types, units and which object types carry them |
| `listDrawings` | read-only | List the document's drawings (paper spaces) with their pages and viewports |
| `getDrawing` | read-only | Return one drawing in full (pages, sheet objects, viewports with their style rules) |
| `createDrawing` | write | Create a drawing with one A3 landscape page at the origin of its paper space and open it as a tab |
| `updateDrawing` | write | Rename a drawing or change its print palette (color | grayscale | monochrome) |
| `removeDrawing` | destructive | Delete a drawing with all its pages and viewports |
| `openDrawing` | write | Show a drawing in its tab (or pass `model: true` to return to the 3D model) |
| `addViewport` | write | Add a viewport to a drawing: a rectangle on the paper (mm) looking at the model from a standard direction (top | bottom | front | back | left | right; default: the 3D camera's nearest axis), fitted to the model extents with a preset scale unless `scale` (1:N denominator) is given |
| `updateViewport` | write | Replace fields of a viewport (full viewport schema minus id/type; unknown fields are ignored) |
| `removeViewport` | destructive | Remove a viewport from a drawing |
| `listComponents` | read-only | List the component definitions this model provides (its model library, installed packages and the built-ins) with their parameter and input tables |
| `getComponentChildren` | read-only | Return the child objects of component instances (by instance id) and each instance's evaluation error, if any |
| `explodeComponents` | destructive | Detach component instances from their children: the instances give up their `childIds` and are removed, the children stay as ordinary objects |
| `listCommands` | read-only | List the commands this model provides (its model library, installed packages and the built-ins) with their input and parameter tables |
| `runCommand` | write | Run a library command (an id from `listCommands`) without prompting, as ONE undo step — an error rolls back everything it applied |

## Object types — required fields

These are the fields you must supply to create each object type; all other
fields have defaults. Use `describe({ type })` for the full field list.

### `beam`

Required when creating: start: Vec3, end: Vec3

### `plate`

Required when creating: polygon: object[]

### `cutPart`

Required when creating: partIds: string[], cutter: object | object

### `cutPlane`

Required when creating: partIds: string[], p1: Vec3, p2: Vec3, p3: Vec3

### `bolt`

Required when creating: partIds: string[], p1: Vec3, p2: Vec3, p3: Vec3

### `weld`

Required when creating: partIds: [string, string], polygon: Vec3[], position: "x+" | "x-" | "y+" | "y-" | "z+" | "z-", edgeAround: "edge" | "around", siteShop: "site" | "shop", shape: "continuous" | "chain" | "staggered", connectAs: "none" | "secondary" | "subassembly", aboveLine: object, belowLine: object, tail: string

### `rebar`

Required when creating: fatherId: string, shapes: Vec3[][], polygon: Vec3[], name: string, grade: string, size: number, bendingRadius: number, class: number, onPlaneCover: number[], fromPlaneCover: number[], startOffset: number, startOffsetType: "cover" | "length", endOffset: number, endOffsetType: "cover" | "length", method: "number" | "target" | "exact" | "exactFirst" | "exactLast" | "exactMiddle" | "exactFirstLast", number: number, spacings: number[], exclude: "none" | "first" | "last" | "firstLast"

### `node`

Required when creating: modelId: string, p: Vec3

### `member1D`

Required when creating: modelId: string, startId: string, endId: string

### `member2D`

Required when creating: modelId: string, nodeIds: string[]

### `member2DOpening`

Required when creating: modelId: string, targetId: string, nodeIds: string[]

### `loadPanel`

Required when creating: modelId: string, targetIds: string[], polygon: Vec3[]

### `hinge2D`

Required when creating: modelId: string, targetId: string, startId: string, endId: string, release: object

### `memberLink`

Required when creating: modelId: string, member1Id: string, member2Id: string

### `nodeLink`

Required when creating: modelId: string, nodeId: string, targetId: string

### `pointSupport`

Required when creating: modelId: string, targetId: string, position: object | object | object, release: object

### `lineSupport`

Required when creating: modelId: string, targetId: string, position: object | object, release: object

### `areaSupport`

Required when creating: modelId: string, targetId: string, position: object | object, release: object

### `pointLoad`

Required when creating: modelId: string, loadCaseId: string, targetId: string, position: object | object | object, direction: "x" | "y" | "z" | "mx" | "my" | "mz", value: number

### `lineLoad`

Required when creating: modelId: string, loadCaseId: string, targetId: string, position: object | object, direction: "x" | "y" | "z" | "mx" | "my" | "mz", value: number | object | object

### `areaLoad`

Required when creating: modelId: string, loadCaseId: string, targetId: string, position: object | object, direction: "x" | "y" | "z" | "mx" | "my" | "mz", value: number

### `loadCase`

Required when creating: modelId: string, name: string, actionType: "permanent" | "variable" | "accidental", variableActionType: "catA" | "catB" | "catC" | "catD" | "catE" | "catF" | "catG" | "catH" | "snow" | "wind" | "temperature" | "ice", duration: "instantaneous" | "short" | "medium" | "long"
